newsitem.title: USA: Lucent, Bell Atlantic in $1 bln deal.
newsitem.headline: Lucent, Bell Atlantic in $1 bln deal.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Thursday it had reached an agreement for Bell Atlantic Corp to purchase up to $1 billion of Lucent switching equipment, software, and other products over the next five years.
As part of the agreement, Bell Atlantic will buy 5ESS(r) switch hardware and software products.

Lucent said the agreement also includes the conversion of a significant portion of Bell Atlantic's network from analog to digital, and the switch interfaces needed to provide more sophisticated digital-based services.

According to Lucent, the 5ESS(r)-2000 switch and its AnyMedia(tm) platform have the ability to provide voice, data, wireless and video services including local, long-distance and international gateway service on a single switch.
The big Lucent-Bell Atlantic deal came as little suprise to analysts and industry executives. They said the way to such an agreement had been opened by the settlement of a lawsuit in March.

Bell Atlantic and DSC Communications Corp settled for undisclosed terms in a $1.6 billion suit against Lucent. The suit had alleged that Lucent was trying to control the market by making telephone equipment that was not compatible with that of rivals.
"At the time of the settlement, Lucent said the level of business with Bell Atlantic would be increasing," said Robert Wilkes, an analyst at Brown Brothers Harriman.

Bell Atlantic and SBC Communications Inc have traditionally bought their call switching equipment from Lucent, while most other regional Bells have allocated a portion of the work to Northern Telecom Ltd.
Northern Telecom declined comment on the Lucent-Bell Atlantic deal.
